text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the summer training camp that doubled 
as rehab coming to an end, Duramente's 
condition was returning to form.
choice_data_list: You gave it your all, Duramente!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I only did what was natural.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: You're the one... who worked hard.
choice_data_list: No, no, I didn't do anything.
No, no, I really didn't do anything.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if that's how you feel. Even so, 
I still want to thank you."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dura!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Groove. Thank you for your hard 
work at the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yeah, good work to you too. So...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...No, it's nothing."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Alright, make sure you don't stay out 
late. ...Do your best in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Could it be that they didn't actually 
have any business with me?
choice_data_list: I bet they just wanted to see your face.

I'm sure they just wanted to see your 
face.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: They must have been worried about you.
They were worried about you, you know.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Groove went home satisfied. That 
must mean... I am "all right."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho. ...I have to answer their 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: To Big Sis Groove's feelings. ...And also.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: And for your dedicated efforts as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If 'the strongest Umamusume wins'... then 
the Kikuka Sho belongs to me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Phew...—

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, weren't this year's Satsuki Sho and 
Japanese Derby insane? 
...Duramente-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that was super cool~. During the 
final stretch, my eyes were glued to you, 
Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
If you ask me who the face of this year's 
Classic generation is, it's definitely 
gotta be Duramente-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Deep down... I kind of thought so 
too."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Thinking it was only natural to live in 
Dura-san's shadow...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: “B-But...! Even so...—”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Who's there?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. And here I intended to watch over 
them in secret.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you come to pick me up? But... I 
want to keep going until the very last 
second."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even if I got left behind... I can't go 
home just yet.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?! You're the 
one leaving me behind, Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
She debuted before me, hit a wall I know 
nothing about... and now she's suffering 
all on her own.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Rely on me too, okay? —We're best friends, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've already informed the teachers that I 
will be taking Kita-chan home in my car.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We've also received permission to use the 
facilities until the last possible minute.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan has... always been a reckless, 
headstrong girl ever since we were kids, 
hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
She works hard, and hard, and harder 
still... You just can't help but root for 
a girl like that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If it's not enough, then run beyond your 
limits. I'll be right here, watching over 
you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Come on, keep at it, Kita-chan! You're not 
the kind of girl to stop here.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No matter what shadow pursues us, we can 
outrun it. —Let's definitely win the 
Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Dia-chan. I'm... heading out!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Heh...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadadadada...!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's it, Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The running of the one I love so 
much—Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Each of their feelings zeroing in on one 
goal— Only a little longer until the 
Kikuka Sho.
